description: The connectome's neuromodulator layer, placed from Bentley et al. 2016 and Ripoll-Sánchez et al. 2023 (both CC BY 4.0). Every producer and receptor cell carries the sources that place it. Peptide couples are the union of both sources under WormBase names, with no common potency cut; `within_500nM` marks the couples the ec50_500nM sensitivity keeps.
